Summarize hierarchy counts

Source: R/prolfqua-deprecated.R
summarize_hierarchy.Rd

E.g compute number of peptides for each protein: for each entry of hierarchy (and of factors), the number of distinct entries of the other hierarchy levels, in columns named <level>_n. Counts experiment-wide, whether observed or not.

Usage

summarize_hierarchy(
  pdata,
  hierarchy_keys,
  hierarchy = hierarchy_keys,
  factors = character()
)

Arguments

pdata

data.frame

hierarchy_keys

character vector - all hierarchy column names

hierarchy

character vector - hierarchy level to group by (default hierarchy_keys)

factors

character vector - factor columns to include

Value

a tibble with one row per combination of the factors and hierarchy columns and, for each other hierarchy level, a column <level>_n with the number of its distinct entries

Note

Deprecated in prolfqua 1.9.5; use LFQData$summarize_hierarchy(). See prolfqua-deprecated.
